facts.fact: Kandan's chalked tile of the dead at dawn names four more Company dead beside Lekha: Orma, Kani and Swathi, of the Company; with Sreedhar, drover of Kalladi, that makes five lines on the visible column. About ten odiyans are dead in all, and the remaining names are not yet chalked.
The tile of the dead is chalked in Kandan's own square hand (per F820).
